notes.title: Lets skip some versions!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there![/h1]

Since our successful Demo Launch on the Steam Next Fest, a small partnership here in Germany and the massive explosion in wishlists, we are happy to announce an update, that will be rolled out to the Demo Version as well!

Spellic 0.4.1 brings many quality of life features, that have been requested many times, such as rebind-able keys, more settings and mod support, as well as a new main menu and inventory trade ups. We will publish for MacOS as well!

Also we are adding Discord Rich Presence Lobby Support [i](that's a word, wow)[/i]. So now you can join other players lobbies directly within Discord, if their lobby is public.

We sadly can't bring every feature to the demo branch, such as Steam Workshop support and the aforementioned inventory, but we are happy to provide as many new features as possible.

[img]https://spellic.stefftek.de/assets/items/other/Axolotl_250.png[/img]

[h2]UI Updates:[/h2]
[list]
    [*]German Localization
    [*]Completely new Flat UI
    [*]New Main Menu
    [*]Pause Menu is now accessible everywhere, even in lobbies
    [*]Complete UI overhaul of the ingame UI
    [*]Better readiness indicators
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Updates:[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Completely new Spell system, expect bugs!
    [*]A new map: [b]The Magic Factory[/b]
    [*]Lobby now starts on a timer
    [*]Better controls while in air
    [*]Improved launch pads
    [*]Capture the Flag as the newest gamemode
[/list]

[h2]New Spells:[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Smoke [/b]makes you disappear!
    [*][b]Lightning [/b]will shock you!
    [*]Be aware of pits with [b]Earthshatter[/b]!
[/list]

[h2]Other Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
    [*]General Settings
    [*]Performance & Stability Improvements
    [*]New Main Menu backgrounds
    [*]Improved Round Win Indicator in Team Deathmatch
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues:[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Due new "Anti-Cheat" (Client Prediction) Movement can feel a bit [i]off.[/i]
    [*]Glichtiness in client syncing
    [*]Server Settings aren't always syncing
[/list]

notes.title: We got a firefly infestation!! AHHH
notes.content:
[h1]This is a major step towards a full Steam release![/h1]
We are proud to announce, that the Steamworks Documentation isn't that awful [i](but still pretty awful).[/i]

Today we announce [b]Steam Inventory Support [/b]- you can play Spellic and earn Items to share and trade. These Items are purely cosmetic [u]wizard companions[/u]. Playtesters will be able to earn a special companion that won't be given out after release. The Fireflew.

Here is a [i]Cute Foxy :3[/i]
[img]https://spellic.stefftek.de/assets/items/cats/Orange_Fox_250.png[/img]
